title: No direct coverage for the by-fast devotional route
reasoning: The feature route is registered as devotionals/by-fast/<int:fast_id>/, but the included devotional API tests exercise only /api/devotionals/ list behavior through _get_list and its search, ordering, cutoff, and limit cases. There is no included assertion that the by-fast URL resolves, returns devotionals for the requested fast, handles a fast with no devotionals, or preserves expected serialization. A regression in the route name, path, or view binding could pass the shown test set.
recommendation: Add a focused API test for GET /api/devotionals/by-fast/<fast_id>/ that creates devotionals for two fasts and asserts only the requested fast's devotionals are returned, plus a not-found or empty-result case matching the intended API contract.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked tests cover the general /api/devotionals/ list endpoint and unrelated fast, email, Bible, Armenian text, and admin behavior; none of the shown tests call /api/devotionals/by-fast/<fast_id>/.
suggestedRegressionTest: In hub/tests/test_devotional_list_api.py or a dedicated devotionals-by-fast test file, create two Fast records with Day and Devotional rows, request /api/devotionals/by-fast/{fast.id}/, assert HTTP 200, assert every returned item belongs to that fast, and assert the other fast's devotional title is absent.
minimumFixScope: Test-only change covering the route and expected filtering behavior.
